changeSet.author: zakaria el kotb
changeSet.sql: create table rubrique_assignment ( id uuid not null, rubrique_id uuid not null, nomenclature_id uuid not null, org_unit_id uuid not null, assigned_by varchar(255), assigned_at timestamp(6) with time zone, primary key (id), constraint uk_rubrique_assignment unique (rubrique_id, org_unit_id) );
alter table rubrique_assignment add constraint fk_assignment_rubrique foreign key (rubrique_id) references nomenclature_rubrique (id);
alter table rubrique_assignment add constraint fk_assignment_nomenclature foreign key (nomenclature_id) references nomenclature (id);
alter table rubrique_assignment add constraint fk_assignment_org_unit foreign key (org_unit_id) references org_unit (id);

rollback.sql: drop table if exists rubrique_assignment cascade;
